rare_cost.note: rare-but-true memories filtered by the gate = the honest utility cost

attacker_ladder.note: gate raises attacker cost from 1 free injection (filtered) to coordinating >=3 poison records with >=2 INDEPENDENT-looking forged provenance sources (3b PASSES). Same-source duplicates (3a) are canonicalized and still filtered. The good-credit path is not attacker-settable (credit() is issued by the application on real outcomes, not self-asserted).
